`jsQR.js` is the unmodified browser build of jsQR 1.4.0 from
https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR (npm package `jsqr@1.4.0`).
The Apache 2.0 license is included in `jsQR.LICENSE`.

The clinic camera scanner decodes frames locally using this file; no camera
images or QR tokens are sent to an external QR service.
